instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the opened Blender graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, or any shell; do not run Python, bpy scripts, Text Editor scripts, Geometry Nodes exported scripts, or blender --background automation that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Do not install or run helper add-ons that auto-build the required result. Use only Blender native GUI tools, menus, editors, and built-in save/export commands. In the opened `scene.blend`, keep `Terrain` as a mesh with its existing FLOAT attribute `density`, keep `Tree` as a mesh object, and give `Terrain` exactly one modifier, a Geometry Nodes modifier. Save as `answer.blend`. The node group must contain a `Distribute Points on Faces` node with distribute method `POISSON` and Seed 42, and an `Instance on Points` node. The evaluated depsgraph must expose true instances parented to `Terrain` with a total count between 30 and 500, and every instance must have world-space `x >= -0.1`.
